name: Hans-Peter Gruber
bio:
Hans-Peter's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in the shadow of the Red Bull Ring. He spent countless hours watching races, mesmerized by the engineering precision and the drivers' skill. After graduating from the Graz University of Technology with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he started his career in a small, family-run racing team, quickly learning the ropes and proving his worth in vehicle dynamics and data analysis. 

He is a firm believer in a holistic approach to performance engineering, focusing not only on technical aspects but also on fostering a collaborative environment within the team. His experience with diverse motorsport categories, from Formula 3 to GT racing, has allowed him to adapt quickly to new challenges. Hans-Peter is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to identify subtle but significant improvements that can make a real difference on the track. He is also an early adopter of new simulation technologies, using them to test car setups before track runs.

Joining MP Motorsport marks an exciting new chapter in his career, where he hopes to leverage his experience and skills to contribute to the team's success at the highest level of competition. His methodical approach is balanced by a willingness to innovate, ensuring that the team remains competitive in the ever-evolving world of motorsport.
